sql: INSERT INTO NXDNP.MV_ORA_XDIFF_TGT (ID, C_NUM_PS) WITH ranked AS ( SELECT x.ID, CASE WHEN t.AMT IS NULL THEN x.C_NUM_PS ELSE x.C_NUM_PS END AS C_NUM_PS, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY x.C_CHAR ORDER BY x.ID) AS rn FROM NXDNP.MV_ORA_XDIFF_SRC x LEFT JOIN NXDNP.MV_ORA_TEST_SRC t ON MOD(x.ID,300)+1 = t.ORDER_ID ) SELECT ID, C_NUM_PS FROM ranked WHERE rn >= 1
